# أَضْطَهِدَ (ʔaḍṭahida) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.hi.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# أُضْطَهَدَ (ʔuḍṭahada) /ʔud
